logline: Busy owners are buried in leads, tools and tasks; DigiKon Solutions brings automation, CRM, web, apps and AI tools together so the work runs more smoothly.
hook: A conversation thread of waiting leads and follow-ups fills the frame from the first second, with the question "Too much to keep up with?"
tone: Professional, modern, confident and trustworthy. Premium and business-focused, in plain customer-centric language. No hype and no numbers.

beats.purpose: Show a stack of unanswered lead messages with a message_thread. VO: "Leads. Follow-ups. Websites. Too much?" Opens on something concrete, not the logo.
Show the service range as four layered cards: GoHighLevel automation, CRM systems, websites, mobile apps. VO: "DigiKon builds automation, CRM, websites and apps."
Show one gesture in a concept-illustration ui_demo with two rows: Product SEO Automation and AI Video Generation. VO: "Plus in-house AI tools for SEO and video."
Hold still on the supplied logo and an end_card with a single invitation. VO: "DigiKon Solutions. Let's talk."

cta: Start the conversation with DigiKon Solutions

art_direction.audience_response: Business owners and marketers should feel "that's the help I need" and start a conversation with DigiKon Solutions.
art_direction.concept: Clarity over clutter: a pile of tasks and leads turns into one calm, ordered set of DigiKon services, ending in a single invitation to talk.
art_direction.visual_metaphor: A pile of messages that settles into neatly stacked cards, showing mess becoming order.

typography.rationale: Bold sans in sentence case reads as modern and trustworthy on LinkedIn. Off-white on the brand deep green-black looks premium and stays legible.

art_direction.composition: Headline top-left with generous space. The picture sits right of or below it. Green accent only on highlights and the button. The logo sits on a white panel in the closing card.

motion_language.description: Clean slides and short wipes that settle firmly. Messages pile up quickly, then cards and rows order themselves calmly.

narrative.opening: Show a stack of waiting leads and follow-ups in a message thread, with the question "Too much?"
narrative.development: Tidy the mess into four service cards, then one gesture in an illustrative interface shows the in-house AI tools.
narrative.conclusion: Hold on the supplied logo and one end card: "Start the conversation with DigiKon Solutions."

claims.text: DigiKon Solutions offers GoHighLevel automation, CRM systems, website development and mobile app development.
claims.safe_alternative: Show the services as named cards in a concept illustration. Make no claim about results, scale or experience.

claims.text: DigiKon has in-house AI tools: Product SEO Automation and AI Video Generation.
claims.safe_alternative: Show the two tool names as concept rows in an illustrative interface. Do not state what they achieve or call the screen the real product.

claims.text: Too many leads, follow-ups and websites can feel like too much to keep up with.
claims.safe_alternative: Ask it as a question ("Too much?") so it describes a familiar feeling and asserts no statistic.

conflicts_log.conflict: No approved brand facts were provided, but the brief wants capabilities shown.
conflicts_log.decision: Register the services and tools as illustrative concepts with null fact ids. Use questions and service names only: no results, numbers, rankings or comparisons.

conflicts_log.conflict: The brand lists Manrope and DM Serif Display, but only one typeface can be used and the system uses a sans.
conflicts_log.decision: Use the sans face (the Manrope-style choice) throughout. Do not use the serif.

conflicts_log.conflict: The brief says no music, but saas_clarity suggests a rhythmic bed.
conflicts_log.decision: No music. Voice-over plus a light interface click on the demo scene only.

conflicts_log.conflict: The brand-story type calls for a belief and human moments, but no photos or facts were supplied.
conflicts_log.decision: Use a compact version of the saas_clarity shape: a recognisable busy-owner moment, the offer, one gesture, one action. Do not invent a founding story.

conflicts_log.conflict: The logo image reads "DIGKON" while the brief says "DigiKon Solutions".
conflicts_log.decision: Show the supplied logo image unaltered through asset_refs. Typeset "DigiKon Solutions" in the end card as plain text, not as a logo. Flag the spelling difference for the client to confirm.

conflicts_log.conflict: The brand light green #81d870 has only 1.64 contrast on the off-white #f7f8f5, so a light background fails the accent check.
conflicts_log.decision: Use the brand dark #03171d as the background and the brand greens as accents. Lighten the muted grey from #647174 to #8fa0a3 so small text stays legible on dark panels. Place the white-background logo on a white panel in the end card.

conflicts_log.conflict: Voice-over limit of 2 words per second.
conflicts_log.decision: Lines are 5, 7, 8 and 4 words for scenes of 3, 4, 4 and 4 seconds, all within the limit.
